import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;
    static final int maxN = 7;
    static final int max2N = 1 << maxN;
    static final int maxM = 100;
    static final int maxS = 64184;
    static final int[] sizes = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};

    static class U128 {
        long low;
        long high;

        U128() {
            low = 0;
            high = 0;
        }

        U128(long low, long high) {
            this.low = low;
            this.high = high;
        }

        void set(int bit) {
            if (bit < 64) {
                low |= (1L << bit);
            } else {
                high |= (1L << (bit - 64));
            }
        }

        boolean get(int bit) {
            if (bit < 64) {
                return (low & (1L << bit)) != 0;
            } else {
                return (high & (1L << (bit - 64))) != 0;
            }
        }

        U128 or(U128 other) {
            return new U128(this.low | other.low, this.high | other.high);
        }

        U128 and(U128 other) {
            return new U128(this.low & other.low, this.high & other.high);
        }

        boolean any() {
            return (low != 0) || (high != 0);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof U128)) return false;
            U128 u = (U128) o;
            return low == u.low && high == u.high;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int)(low ^ (low >>> 32) ^ high ^ (high >>> 32));
        }

        static U128 fromBit(int n) {
            U128 res = new U128();
            res.set(n);
            return res;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<U128> bfs = new ArrayList<>();
    static HashMap<U128, Integer> id = new HashMap<>();
    static int[][] nxttt = new int[max2N][maxS];
    static int[] match = new int[maxS];
    static long[][] p = new long[maxN][maxM];
    static long[] prv = new long[maxS];
    static long[] cur = new long[maxS];

    static long powmod(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= mod;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = res * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int bit(int n) {
        return 1 << n;
    }

    static int getInd(U128 state) {
        Integer idx = id.get(state);
        if (idx != null) return idx;
        int newIdx = bfs.size();
        bfs.add(state);
        id.put(state, newIdx);
        return newIdx;
    }

    static void precalc(int n) {
        int N = bit(n);
        U128[] fixedSize = new U128[maxN + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) fixedSize[i] = new U128();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            fixedSize[cnt] = fixedSize[cnt].or(U128.fromBit(mask));
        }
        bfs.clear();
        id.clear();
        id = new HashMap<>(sizes[n] * 2);
        ArrayList<U128> stk = new ArrayList<>();
        U128 one = new U128(1, 0);
        getInd(one);
        stk.add(one);
        while (!stk.isEmpty()) {
            U128 state = stk.remove(stk.size() - 1);
            int k = id.get(state);
            U128[] predHall = new U128[maxN];
            for (int i = 0; i < maxN; i++) predHall[i] = new U128();
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                if (state.and(U128.fromBit(mask)).any()) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        predHall[i] = predHall[i].or(U128.fromBit(mask | bit(i)));
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                U128 nxt = new U128(state.low, state.high);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) {
                        nxt = nxt.or(predHall[i]);
                    }
                }
                if (!id.containsKey(nxt)) {
                    stk.add(nxt);
                }
                nxttt[mask][k] = getInd(nxt);
            }
            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (state.and(fixedSize[i]).any()) {
                    match[k] = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long expectedMaximumMatching(int n, int m) {
        for (int k = 0; k < bfs.size(); k++) prv[k] = 0;
        prv[0] = 1;
        int N = bit(n);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < bfs.size(); k++) cur[k] = 0;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    prob = prob * ((mask & bit(i)) != 0 ? p[i][j] : (mod + 1 - p[i][j])) % mod;
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < bfs.size(); k++) {
                    cur[nxttt[mask][k]] = (cur[nxttt[mask][k]] + prob * prv[k]) % mod;
                }
            }
            long[] temp = prv;
            prv = cur;
            cur = temp;
        }
        long ans = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < bfs.size(); k++) {
            if (match[k] == n) ans = (ans + prv[k]) % mod;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n;
        precalc(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                p[i][j] = sc.nextLong();
                p[i][j] = p[i][j] * powmod(100, mod - 2) % mod;
            }
        }
        long ans = expectedMaximumMatching(n, m);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
